subject: Mobile Development
title: Material Design: Google's Vision
description: One-minute skill: Material Design: Google's Vision.

hook.text: In 2014, Google published a design language that unified Android, web, and everything between.

buildup.text: Material Design uses layers, shadows, and bold colors to create a sense of physical depth.

discovery.text: The system provides components, guidelines, and tools so any developer can build polished UIs.

twist.text: Material You in 2021 added dynamic color themes that adapt to your wallpaper automatically.

climax.text: Material Design gave Android a consistent visual identity it never had before.

punchline.text: One design system unified a fragmented platform.

quiz.question: What is Material Design?
options: Google's design language for apps and web
